verdict.rationale: Databricks documents several headless automation surfaces. The CLI is described as working "from your local terminal or automation scripts," and the Python SDK is presented as a way to "automate Databricks operations." Versioned workspace REST APIs are documented, with CLI, Terraform and SDK examples, and Databricks Connect can be embedded in any application. Together these clearly support scripted, non-interactive runs. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions or deployment bundles), documented non-interactive or service-principal authentication for CI runners, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
